name: streams
meaning: StreamSound[2] (0x94 each); double-buffered: the loader fills the idle one

name: activeSlot
meaning: index of the playing stream; the loader uses (activeSlot-1)&1

name: bankLoaded
meaning: set to 1 by Load_MusicVoiceBank once MusicVoice.BSV is read (0x5638e6); zeroed by the ctor (0x563662)

name: clipNames
meaning: per-clip allocated entries from Load_MusicVoiceBank, used as file names by 0x563bd0

name: path
meaning: full clip path built from 0x6d5220 + clip name; the loader thread argument. Length inferred from the next field

name: state
meaning: stream state machine (3 load-next, 5 fade-out, 6 wait-for-load...), per 0x563bd0

name: pausedState
meaning: state saved by 0x5642e0 on pause (0x5642f5) and restored on resume (0x56431b); zeroed by the ctor (0x56367c)

name: autoPlay
meaning: 1 by ctor: StreamSound_Play after a load completes

name: stateStartMs
meaning: g_rawTimeMs when the state was entered (fade/timeout timing)
